title: The Observatory Floor
subtitle: the sky, modelled in brass and nodes
description: The chapter's own `dependencyStyle` sets the orbital default: every
line in this room draws radial, dashed, with a dot at its target and
a thin weight, unless a quest says otherwise. Most of them say
otherwise. That is the other half of the demonstration -- the
chapter default is what every override is measured against.
The seven stars of the Plough reveal themselves one link at a time:
each carries `hideUntilDependenciesVisible`, which is recursive, so
a chain uncovers itself from its first visible end and a star nobody
has reached stays off the canvas entirely.
